messages:
rachel: FYI scheduled the user_email_normalize migration for 02:00 UTC in the maintenance window. I just noticed the nightly analytics backfill (job #alg-backfill-09) is also targeting the users table then. potential lease conflict.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: preflight: trying to acquire migration lease user_email_normalize v1. lease_id=mx-44b1 TTL=1200s.
analytics-bot: alg-backfill-09: acquiring cross-table lease for analytics backfill. lease_id=alg-09-hx TTL=3600s. window start 01:50 UTC.
tom_sre: both are in same shard-set. past collisions caused a PK swap stall. options: delay migration, shift earlier, or use deploybot--stagger fallback.
db_sam: migration needs a short exclusive quiesce for the email canonicalization rename. backfill is read-heavy but holds a long-lived snapshot/lease. If backfill wins, migration will spin until lease expires ~1h. not ideal.
lena: can we run migration earlier at 01:30 UTC? that would finish before backfill picks up. downside: changes overlap with late-night monitoring window.
rachel: prefer to keep window but avoid changing monitoring. What about recoverable preemption: deploybot has `--preemptible` mode which asks backfill to checkpoint and yield if flagged.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: command available: `/deploybot lease-preempt --target migration --reason "hotfix email canonicalization" --grace=600s` (dry_run supported).
tom_sre: concern: preempting long backfills causes resume overhead and might push analytics beyond SLA. we need explicit owner sign-off from analytics.
analytics-bot: alg-team: support preemption only if we get an auto-resume token and ETA estimation. we can accept a 10m pause but not cancel.
db_sam: we can add a short stagger policy: if an analytics lease exists and has >50% progress, migration waits 10m. else preempt. that keeps things automated.
rachel: that policy sounds reasonable. Can we pin the reader service that touches users to v3.1-readpin during the migration so we avoid schema drift?
tom_sre: yes, add routing pin for 30m readpin=v3.1-readpin. I'll add a temporary alert runbook in case lock_waits spike > 8s.
rachel: ok proceeding: I'll issue a dry run of preempt to see handshake. `/deploybot lease-preempt --target migration --reason "email-canon" --dry_run`
deploy-bot: Deploybot: dry_run handshake initiated. migration=user_email_normalize v1 requests preempt. current lease owner=alg-09-hx. suggested action=stagger 10m (analytics progress=42%).
analytics-bot: alg-backfill-09: progress 42%, checkpoint ETA ~18m. can accept 10m stagger. logging consent: https://ci/redwood/jobs/alg-backfill-09/consent
rachel: great. schedule migration at 02:00 -> 02:10 UTC and add deploy pin so no other waves start earlier. also pin readers to v3.1-readpin.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: scheduling migration user_email_normalize v1 at 1732110600 (02:10 UTC). routing_pin applied: service-readers -> v3.1-readpin TTL=1800s. migration pin: do-not-start-earlier=1732110600.
db_sam: prepping rollback playbook: if PK swap fails, revert rename, keep old column until compat shim removed. DB oncall paged.
tom_sre: adding a safety circuit: if db.lock_waits > 10s for 3m -> auto-abort migration and reassign lease back to analytics job, with postmortem required.
rachel: migration starting now. monitor: `pg_stat_activity` and `pg_locks`.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: starting migration task run_id=run-1732110600-1. logs: https://deploylog/redwood/migrations/run-1732110600-1
analytics-bot: alg-backfill-09: received preempt request, checkpointing to stable snapshot.
idx: alg-backfill-09: checkpoint complete at 42% and yielded lease. resume token created: resume://alg/09/token-8
db_sam: applying quiesce: `SELECT pg_advisory_lock(42424242)` then performing background normalize backfill.
tom_sre: seeing a transient alert: db.lock_waits metric fired (8.6s) once. I'm watching; threshold for auto-abort is 10s.
rachel: observed a brief spike in tail latency to 220ms, ok.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: progress 18% - background normalization rows processed.
analytics-bot: note: resume ETA after migration ~12m. we will resume automatically using token-8.
db_sam: nearing critical index swap. preparing atomic swap step.
tom_sre: alert spiked again: db.lock_waits 12s for 2m. auto-abort condition approaching.
rachel: hold abort for 1 more minute, I'm running manual query to inspect blocked PIDs.
db_sam: blocked PID is old analytics vacuum process; it's leaking due to replica lag. I can kill that PID and unstick.
tom_sre: kill approved. `SELECT pg_terminate_backend(<pid>);` executed.
analytics-bot: alg-backfill-09: noticed termination; resuming from token-8 after migration completes.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: lock_wait alert cleared. migration progress 62%.
db_sam: performing PK swap now with minimal lock time.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: PK swap executed. migration run-1732110600-1 success. releasing lease mx-44b1. audit: https://deploylog/redwood/migrations/run-1732110600-1/success
rachel: excellent. removing read pin now and scheduling post-mortem notes.
tom_sre: creating infra ticket: auto-stagger policy detection for conflicting long-lived leases (proposal: if lease TTL > 30m and progress < 80% then schedule migration after 10m unless owner consents).
lena: opening a CI test to flag overlapping analytic jobs during maintenance window.
rachel: updating release notes: "user_email_normalize applied with automated preempt handshake; edge lock resolved by terminating stale vacuum."
analytics-bot: alg-backfill-09: resumed at token-8; ETA to finish 12m.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: closing thread for migration 1732109999.
